task_description: Pro-VC Dashboard improvements: full faculty names + 2-band legend in the FFI charts, a Pro-VC Comments thread (view/write/save to MongoDB) keyed by faculty+course via a new backend API, wired into the Analytics Need-Attention rows and the Full View (header + per-row buttons), plus a modern Full View redesign and an Action Taken button in the Full View actions row. Reuse existing APIs; no dummy data; React + Tailwind only; verify with `npm run build`.
